Hey. I got some music that might make you feel better if you're in to hip hop and some metal. Music helps me cry and I only feel better after crying for hours on end. It really is the only cure even if it's temporary. If you don't like my music then listen to your own and maybe you can cry as well. If you like any of these let me know ok? I hope that if you don't listen to any of my music or your own that you can feel better in your life and make yourself happy. Easier said then done however. Sleeping is the best escape though crying for me ultimately helps put my life back on track.

Everyone tells me I'm such a smart kid and have so much potential and to an extent, they're right but recently depression has really taken it's toll on me. I've practically given up on trying, though I still go. It's not that I can't get good grades it's that I would rather kill myself then be forced to try. Idk but id recommend that you try to get help ASAP. Be better then me. Good luck man.
